anchors.name: Asan
anchors.note: Asan Barrage (OSM dam way at 30.437 N, 77.666 E). OSM names the channel upstream of it "Tons Nadi" and has no named Asan waterway in the window, so "Asan" applies from the barrage reach to the Yamuna.

anchors.name: Meghna
anchors.note: Lower Meghna below the Padma confluence near Chandpur, Bangladesh.

naming.propagation: Names of reaches draining at least 300 km² continue downstream until another named reach.
